size.description: The size of the instrument field.

hasSrc.description: Whether to show the source (src) field.

maxDigits.description: The maximum number of integer digits to show (for zero padding).

showZeroPadding.description: Whether to show leading zeros up to maxDigits.

fractionDigits.description: The number of decimal places to display.

tag.description: The tag or label for the data (e.g., "HDG", "SPD").

neutralColor.description: If true, uses a neutral color scheme instead of the default instrument color.

horizontal.description: If true, uses a horizontal layout.

labelOnly.description: If true, only the label (tag and unit) is displayed.

off.description: If true, displays the "off" state (e.g., showing "OFF" instead of value).

autoHideSetpoint.description: If true, automatically hides the setpoint when the value is close to it.

autoHideDeadband.description: The deadband within which the setpoint is hidden if autoHideSetpoint is true.

componentSize.description: Component size: regular, medium, large or xl.
